front: Thorny brush bursts from the ground, hurting creatures there and leaving hazardous difficult terrain until your next turn.
back:
Creatures in area take 1d4 piercing damage, basic Reflex save.
Until start of your next turn the area is difficult and hazardous terrain; a creature entering a square takes 1d4 piercing damage (basic Reflex).
Heightened (+2): initial damage +1d4; hazardous terrain damage +1.
